content.title: 19 Easter Egg Hunts Around Northern Virginia
content.text: Have an egg-citing time at one of these local events. Easter egg hunts make the Easter holiday so much more fun. If you’re looking for some options beyond your backyard, we’ve rounded up 20 to choose from. Preteen Flashlight Egg Hunt at Manassas Park March 27, 7–8 p.m.99 Adams St., Manassas, ages 8–11 only, $7 Ida Lee Park March 28, noon–3 p.m.60 Ida Lee Park, NW, Leesburg, $10 advance only March 28, 1–5:15 p.m. 814 Ferndale Ave., Herndon, $10 in advance; $15 on site, if space allows (includes one parent and one child) Spring Egg Scavenger Hunt at Bull Run Park March 28–April 5, 8 a.m.–8 p.m.7700 Bull Run Drive, Centreville, $8 Spring Egg Hunt at Potomac Overlook Regional Park March 28–April 5, 10:30 a.m.–4 p.m.2845 N.
